caption: The drawing depicts a single copper-colored metal bucket with two large curved handles attached on opposite sides. The bucket is shown in a three-quarters view, revealing its round, slightly flared body with three horizontal bands encircling it. The handles are thick and arch above the rim of the bucket, looping upward in a smooth curve. The surface of the bucket features a textured appearance with shades of reddish-brown, gold, and traces of green and blue patina, with the colors layered to suggest the reflective and worn nature of metal. The background is plain and off-white. In the lower right corner, there is a handwritten signature and date in red-brown that reads “R.W.R. TAYLOR. 1936.”
title: Holy Water Bucket
